parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan assembly consisting of blades and the central hub, made of aluminum for lightweight and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation in a room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the ceiling fan, including the motor housing and the rod connecting to the ceiling mount, made of steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the motor and supports the fan blades, ensuring stable rotation and attachment to the ceiling.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while supporting the rotating fan blades.
